newsitem.title: USA: Goldman cut Telefonica because of price.
newsitem.headline: Goldman cut Telefonica because of price.

text.p: Goldman Sachs said on Tuesday it had cut its rating for Telefonica de Espana SA because the company had reached the firm's price target.
Goldman Sachs analyst Stuart Birdt downgraded the company to market outperform from a trading buy.
The firm had set a short-term price target of 2,550 to 2,600 pesetas a share. The shares closed in Madrid on Monday at 2,645 pesetas.
"With the attainment of our price objective, we are removing Telefonica de Espana shares from our trading buy list," Birdt wrote in a report.
"Nonetheless, our fundamental view of the shares remains positive and we therefore rate the shares market outperformers."
